seoTitle: Classroom Seating Chart Generator: Random and Printable
metaDescription: Paste a class list, set desks per row and aisles, and get a random seating plan with optional front-row students. Free, nothing uploaded.
intro: Shuffles a list of names into a rows-and-desks seating plan, with optional aisles and students who must sit in the front row.
why:
A fresh seating plan takes a minute: paste the names, choose how many desks are in a row, and the chart appears with the front of the class at the top. Put an exclamation mark before a name to seat that student in the front row.

The shuffle is seeded, so the same seed gives the same plan and a new seed gives a new one. Empty desks are placed in the back row. The names stay on your device, which matters for a class list. Print the chart from your browser.
howTo: Paste one name per line; start a name with ! for the front row.
Set desks per row and the aisle spacing.
Change the seed to shuffle again.

faq.a: No. It stays in your browser.

faq.q: Can I drag students to seats?
faq.a: No, change the seed or edit the list.

faq.q: Can I keep two students apart?
faq.a: Not directly; reshuffle until you like the result.
